Summary
: The present work is an attempt to offer a theistic account in the English language of the career and teachings of Sri Chaitanya (representing the Absolute Truth in His full manifestation). Sri Chaitanya came into this world to make all people understand that in reference to their eternal existence they should have nothing to do with non-Godhead.
Auspicatory observance:—Obeisance to Sri Guru, the devotees and the Supreme Lord. Sri Krishna Chaitanya did not appear primarily for delivering conditioned souls. The Real Purpose of His Appearance concerns Himself as He is. Godhead is willing and able to disclose His Own Specific Self.
